overview: Extract TaskScheduleDatePickerViewModel from TaskScheduleDatePickerSheet (182 lines) and deduplicate nearestRoundedHour() shared with ReminderEditorView. VM manages date/time state and picker expansion.
goals: Create @Observable TaskScheduleDatePickerViewModel owning dueDate, hasTime, expandedPicker state
Extract nearestRoundedHour() to Utilities/DateRounding.swift shared utility
Reduce sheet from ~182 lines to ~100 lines
nonGoals: No changes to callback-based communication with parent views
rules: VM owns local state only; parent callback is preserved
nearestRoundedHour extracted as standalone public function
Third story depends on first two due to deduplication

stories.title: Extract nearestRoundedHour() shared utility
stories.description: Create DateRounding.swift with public nearestRoundedHour(from:) function. Update ReminderEditorView to use it and remove the private duplicate.
acceptanceCriteria: File TaskFlow/Utilities/DateRounding.swift exists with public nearestRoundedHour(from:) function (1.1)
ReminderEditorView updated to call shared utility instead of private method (1.2)

stories.title: Create TaskScheduleDatePickerViewModel
stories.description: Create the ViewModel file with @Observable class, init, and date/time toggle methods using the shared rounding utility.
acceptanceCriteria: init(initialDueDate:) matching current view init logic (2.3)
toggleDate(isEnabled:) with date defaulting and picker state (2.4)
toggleTime(isEnabled:) with rounding via shared utility (2.5)

stories.title: Refactor TaskScheduleDatePickerSheet to use ViewModel and verify
stories.description: Wire ViewModel into the sheet and verify all workflows.
acceptanceCriteria: All @State properties replaced with VM bindings (3.2)
Schedule sheet opens with correct initial state (4.2)
